name: JobsPipe: Company Hiring Signals
description: Get hiring momentum and activity signals for a company
notes: Replace YOUR_JOBSPIPE_API_KEY with your actual API key
Replace {{company_domain}} with a Clay column reference
Returns hiring activity summary for the company
Use total_open_jobs and last_posted to gauge hiring velocity
Costs 1 credit per company (free if already paid this month)
For deeper insights, get company profile with /v1/jobs/companies/{key}
